_comment: MongoRaftReconfig LOGV2 id -> trace event mapping. Verified against the pristine mongodb/mongo 8.x source under src/mongo/db/repl. 'kind' tells parse_logs.py how to treat each: 'event' = consumed as a trace event (has a Trace.tla wrapper); 'marker' = used only to disambiguate the 21392 config-install (dropped from the final trace). The three install flavors (StepUpReconfig / ConfigInstallCmd / ConfigInstallHB) are all LOGV2 21392 and are split in a post-pass from surrounding markers + (version,term) delta.

21450.note: Election succeeded, assuming primary role. attr.term = new election term (reliable).

6015310.note: Starting to transition to primary. (drain complete -> writable primary). No full-state attr; state from poll.

21392.note: New replica set config in use. attr.config = full ReplSetConfig BSON (version, term, members[]). Rewritten to StepUpReconfig | ConfigInstallCmd | ConfigInstallHB in post-pass.

21827.note: Updating term. Secondary adopts higher term. attr.newTerm = adopted term (reliable).

21355.note: Stepping down from primary, because we received a new config.

21475.note: Stepping down from primary in response to heartbeat.

6015313.note: Replication config state is Steady, starting reconfig. Tags the NEXT 21392 on this node as ConfigInstallCmd (command path).

4615622.note: Received new config via heartbeat (LOGV2_FOR_HEARTBEATS lvl1). Tags the NEXT 21392 on this node as ConfigInstallHB (heartbeat path).

51814.note: Persisting new config to disk (command path, between begin and install).

4508103.note: Increment the config term via reconfig. UNIQUE signal of the optimized step-up (doOptimizedReconfig) — present on the new primary's OWN configTerm bump, absent on heartbeat-propagated step-up configs. Tags the next 21392 as StepUpReconfig (takes priority over the co-occurring cmd markers).

6351200.note: New heartbeat config is only a version/term change, skipping validation checks. Marks a heartbeat-propagated step-up config install (version unchanged, term bumped) -> ConfigInstallHB on the receiving secondary.
